details: In ccci, there is a possible out of bounds write due to a missing bounds check. This could lead to remote denial of service with no additional execution privileges needed. User interaction is needed for exploitation. Patch ID: ALPS11523478 (Note: For MT6880, MT6890) / ALPS11297423 (Note: For MT6813, MT6986, MT6982, MT6980D) / AUTO00864897 (Note: For MT2735, MT2737); Issue ID: MSV-10724.
